templates.name: Recovery vault
templates.summary: Owner can recover funds to a known recovery key if normal control is compromised.
templates.nextBuild: Split owner and recovery keys in the UI instead of using one saved test key for both.

templates.name: Delayed withdrawal vault
templates.summary: Owner withdrawals must wait until the covenant lock condition is satisfied.
templates.nextBuild: Add a visible request, waiting, release state machine around the spend draft.

templates.name: Spending cap vault
templates.summary: Normal spending is capped while recovery can still sweep the full balance.
templates.nextBuild: Move the cap from planner intent into enforceable Silverscript output rules.

templates.name: Merchant escrow
templates.summary: Buyer funds a conditional output; seller can release, buyer can refund after timeout.
templates.nextBuild: Create a separate Escrow.sil contract with buyer, seller, release, refund, and cancel paths.
